answer_1.quote: We have conduct experiments on a variety of text generation tasks: machine translation, tableto-text, image captioning, commonsense genteration, and keyword-to-dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: We assess the performance of INSTRUCTSCORE using Segment-level Kendall and Pearson correlations between human and metric output.

answer_3.quote: We leverage GPT-4 to extract representative explainable knowledge that can greatly contribute to the subsequent Exp-Generator learning process.

answer_4.quote: We hired three human raters to annotate IN-STRUCTSCORE's diagnostic reports.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters will estimate a binary score based on M1 to M6 and G1 to G4 criteria for each field in the diagnostic report.
